introHtml: Leather bowls, plates, and trays bring a refined, tactile quality to promotional merchandise that plastic or ceramic simply cannot match. For corporate gift sets, VIP client appreciation, or upscale event swag, leather lends an air of craftsmanship and durability. These pieces often feature debossed logos or foil stamping, making your brand mark subtle yet memorable. Whether used as a catchall on a desk or a serving tray in a conference room, custom leather bowls, plates, and trays signal attention to detail and lasting value.
